decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in two successive years, so its value has largely been realized, and as a seasonal product close to the core offer it costs little to keep.

The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning of the other new breads and still has its own page, so its option remains open at low carrying cost, though the lack of reported results leaves its value uncertain.
The marzipan stollen is a cheap seasonal extension of an established, award-winning stollen line and keeps its own page, so keeping the option costs little and it adds to the gift assortment.
